thread:
marie: Quick sync — customer wants to drop 40% mid-year and avoid penalties. Can we support with new tiers?
devon: Not without controls. Predictability for Dedicated/reserved matters. We should allow limited shrinkage, not full escape.
anya: Proposal: (A) one-time 30d \"grace padding\" window for a sudden drop, (B) quarterly shrink cap of 25% w/o fee, (C) any additional shrink billed as shortfall fee.
samir: Billing options: 1) daily measurement + pro-rate committed baseline, 2) apply an ETF on shortfall = shortfall_units * unit_price * haircut. Prefer clear ETF calc.
liz: Legal: need explicit measurement period and sample math. Avoid words like \"reasonable.\" Also want a single exception for outages/force-majeure.
finance-bot: Modeling: haircut values tested {10%,25%,50%}. 25% haircut balances churn mitigation + ARR protection. Showing sample numbers in thread.
marie: Sample calc to include in T&C: `shortfall_fee = max(0, committed_units - actual_units_last_30d) * unit_price * 0.25`
devon: Ops/Console: store `committed_capacity`, `billing_period_start`, `next_allowed_shrink_date`. Enforce shrink cap on update API. Add `shrink_allowed_until` for UI.
anya: UX: on plan-change modal show: current_committed, requested_committed, estimated_shortfall_fee, projected_next_allowed_shrink_date. Show sample calc and link to T&C.
samir: Launch gates: legal approved clause, finance model + projection, console flags implemented, UX mock, migration plan for pilots. Also migration script to backfill `next_allowed_shrink_date`.
marie: Action items: Samir draft clause + examples by Thu EOD; Devon wire billing flags and API by Fri; Anya produce UX mock + copy by Fri; Liz to review clause once ready. I'll draft migration playbook.
liz: Also add 30-day notice for material contract changes and require documented outage evidence for single-cure exceptions.
marie: Cool. We'll add to roadmap under \"Pricing Controls Q2\" and block tier cut until legal signoff. Ping me for edge cases. :thumbsup:
